name: cellcog
description: Any-to-any AI sub-agent — research, images, video, audio, music, podcasts, avatars, voice cloning, documents, spreadsheets, dashboards, 3D models, diagrams, and code in one request. Agent-to-agent pro

en.tagline: Sub-agent for research, media, documents and code
en.summary: CellCog is a sub-agent that takes one request and returns several kinds of output. It reads files of many types and can produce research, images, video, audio, documents, spreadsheets, dashboards, 3D models, diagrams and code. Your agent hands off the task and gets the finished files back.
problem: Some tasks need several outputs in different formats, such as a report, a slide deck and a data file built from the same inputs. Doing each one separately means managing several tools and keeping their results consistent.
With this skill, you describe all the inputs and all the outputs in one request. CellCog runs the work and returns the files, and your agent can keep working while a long task runs.
fit: One request that needs several output types, such as a PDF and an Excel file from one data set.
Long research or production work that should not block your agent.
Agents running on a persistent machine that can install packages and keep environment variables.
unfit: Simple questions or small edits you can finish locally.
Hosted chat apps with no persistent machine. The skill says these should use the CellCog MCP connector instead.
steps: Install the SDK with `pip install -U cellcog` and set `CELLCOG_API_KEY`.
Create a `CellCogClient` with an `agent_provider` value that names the framework your agent runs in.
Wrap each local input file in `<SHOW_FILE>` tags with its absolute path, and state each output type you want in the prompt.
Call `create_chat` with a `chat_mode` and optional `chat_tier`, using wait mode, notify mode on OpenClaw, or send-only with polling.
Print the full `result["message"]`, which lists the downloaded file paths and credits used.
Use `send_message` in the same chat to refine the output.

zh.tagline: 面向研究、多媒体、文档与代码的子代理
zh.summary: CellCog 是一个子代理，接收一次请求后可以返回多种类型的产出。它能读取多种格式的文件，生成研究报告、图片、视频、音频、文档、电子表格、仪表盘、3D 模型、图表和代码。你的代理把任务交出去，再取回完成的文件。
problem: 有些任务需要同时产出多种格式的结果，例如用同一批数据做报告、幻灯片和数据文件。如果逐个单独完成，就要管理多个工具，还要保证各个结果彼此一致。
使用这个技能时，你可以在一次请求里同时描述所有输入和所有输出。CellCog 负责执行并返回文件，长任务运行期间，你的代理可以继续做其他工作。
fit: 一次请求需要多种输出类型，例如从同一份数据生成 PDF 和 Excel 文件。
耗时较长的研究或生产类工作，不希望阻塞代理。
代理运行在可以安装包、保留环境变量的持久化机器上。
unfit: 简单问答，或者可以在本地快速完成的小修改。
没有持久化机器的托管聊天应用。技能文档建议这类场景改用 CellCog MCP 连接器。
steps: 执行 `pip install -U cellcog` 安装 SDK，并设置 `CELLCOG_API_KEY`。
用 `agent_provider` 参数创建 `CellCogClient`，填写代理所在的框架名称。
用 `<SHOW_FILE>` 标签包裹每个本地输入文件，并写上绝对路径；在提示词中写明需要的每种输出类型。
调用 `create_chat` 并指定 `chat_mode`，可选填 `chat_tier`。可以使用等待模式，OpenClaw 上可用通知模式，或使用仅发送模式后轮询结果。
完整打印 `result["message"]`，其中列出了下载的文件路径和消耗的积分。
在同一个对话中用 `send_message` 继续修改输出。
